//@version=5
indicator("Independent TA default clocks")
seed=array.new_int(1,1)

method read(array<int> receiver, value = ta.cum(close)) => value
observe() =>
    always = seed.read()
    var float occasional = na
    if bar_index % 2 == 0
        occasional := seed.read()
    [always,occasional]
[always,occasional] = request.security("REMOTE:ALT","1",observe())
plot(always,"Always")
plot(occasional,"Occasional")
